captions.caption: A man with long hair sits in a rocky outdoor setting.
The man looks into the distance with a serious expression.
Close-up of the man's face as he observes his surroundings.
The man remains seated, leaning against a large rock.
He looks thoughtfully towards the camera's right side.
A wide shot shows the man sitting alone in a desert canyon.
The man sits quietly amidst the large boulders of the canyon.
He is seen from a distance, resting in the shade.
The man takes in the view of the surrounding rock formations.
He sits motionless, blending into the natural environment.
A green tree stands tall against a bright blue sky.
The camera captures the leaves of the tree in the sunlight.
The tree branches move gently in the breeze.
A close-up view of cold, grey ashes in a fire pit.
The remains of a small fire are scattered among the rocks.
The camera pans across the extinguished embers.
The man's hands appear, reaching for wooden poles.
He begins to pull apart a structure made of sticks.
The man gathers the sticks to clear the area.
He removes the wooden supports from the rock wall.
Primitive tools and a woven bag lie on a flat surface.
A close-up shot shows the texture of the woven items.
The camera focuses on the gear spread out on the ground.
The man walks across the rocky ground carrying sticks.
He prepares to scatter the materials back into nature.
Text appears explaining he is returning the area to its natural condition.
The man throws the bundle of sticks into the canyon.
He continues to toss the wooden pieces away from the site.
The man works quickly to dismantle his temporary shelter.
He walks back to the shelter to pick up more items.
The man bends over to grab a large stone.
He lifts a rock from the low wall he constructed.
The man tosses the rock onto the ground to scatter it.
He picks up another large stone from the pile.
The man continues to dismantle the rock wall.
He throws a rock away into the dry canyon bed.
The man reaches for the remaining stones to clear them.
The sun shines brightly over the top of a rocky cliff.
A lens flare occurs as the camera points towards the sun.
A tall rock spire rises sharply into the clear sky.
The camera pans across the rugged mountain landscape.
A wide view shows the vast, rocky terrain of the canyon.
The landscape is dry and filled with red rock formations.
The man walks through a stream bed with flowing water.
Text on screen notes the presence of surface water in the canyon.
The man hikes along the small, clear stream.
He steps carefully on the rocks near the running water.
The man continues his journey deeper into the canyon.
He is seen walking past large, dark rock walls.
The man navigates the rocky path alongside the stream.
He moves steadily through the rugged desert terrain.
The man stops to look at the water flowing by.
Text appears discussing the year-round availability of the water.
The man walks forward, following the course of the stream.
He steps over stones in the shallow water.
The man continues his hike through the sunlit canyon.
He moves gracefully over the uneven, rocky ground.
The man is shown walking towards a new location.
He walks past a small pool of water in the stream bed.
The man disappears into the distance of the canyon.
